integrity: The proof independently converts the published material-implication clauses into set operations on team propositions, constructs explicit singleton-consequent witnesses for every failure of the stated antecedent conditions, and proves the converse closure implications. The primary full text was inspected at the team-proposition closure definitions, material and weak material clauses, inferential characterization, Appendix A counterexamples, and concluding classification question. Candidate-specific published-finding and literature searches did not locate the exact antecedent-wise boundary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a team-proposition-level classification for strong and weak material implication. It does not classify arbitrary conditional operators or the convexity-preservation boundary. The principal-ideal corollary uses the finite valuation base assumed in the source.
title: Exact antecedent boundary for material-implication closure in team semantics
